articles.title: BitMart withdrawals appear to slow following wind-down announcement
articles.snippet: Users reported withdrawal delays and freeze notices as wallets attributed to BitMart fell to about $69 million and its BMX token extended an 81.5% weekly decline.

articles.title: BitMart to wind down exchange, end trading by Aug. 26
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange BitMart said it will wind down operations after its BMX token plunged and users reported withdrawal delays, with platform operations set to end in January.
